Arcana.Journal.Title: Supernatural Journal
Arcana.LifeState.Description.Fairy: Life is a little more magical when you've got wings! Whether you're using your powers to help flowers bloom or playing tricks on unsuspecting Sims, there is never a dull moment when you're a fairy. Will you use your pixie dust to help spread joy to those around you, or spend your days causing mischief wherever you go?
Arcana.LifeState.Description.Genie: With the power to grant wishes and do the impossible, being a genie certainly has its perks! No longer bound that dusty old lamp, you're free to make the most of your magical abilities. Will you use your powers to continue to help others achieve their wildest dreams, or keep a few wishes for yourself?
Arcana.LifeState.Description.Ghost: Death doesn't have to be the end of the story! You've managed to stick around in the land of the living, and now you've got all the time in the world to make the most of your afterlife. Will you spend eternity watching over your loved ones, or have a little fun?
Arcana.LifeState.Description.Mermaid: There's a whole world waiting beneath the waves, and you've got the tail to explore it! Life on land has its charms, but nothing feels quite like a swim in the open sea. Will you stay close to shore and keep one foot in the human world, or follow the tide and discover what lies below?
Arcana.LifeState.Description.Vampire: Eternal life comes with its fair share of problems, but being a creature of the night certainly has its advantages. Will you cling to your human habits, surviving on plasma packs and avoiding the sun? Or will you give in to your vampiric nature and discover just how powerful you can become?
Arcana.LifeState.Description.Werewolf: Being a werewolf is both a blessing and a curse, depending on who you ask. Will you fight to tame the beast within and live a relatively normal life? Or will you give in to your wild side?
Arcana.LifeState.Description.Witch: Born with the gift of magic, you have the power to bend even reality to your will. Will you spend your days studying spells and bringing good fortune to those around you, or torment your enemies with wicked curses?

Arcana.Witch.Fizzle.Description: That spell sputtered out in a puff of smoke! Until the frustration wears off, Magical Power will be slow to recover.
Arcana.Witch.Fizzle.Name: Magical Fizzle
Arcana.Witch.Perk.AlchemicalSavant.Descr: A drop of desire, a pinch of passion, and just a hint of lust. {name}'s talent for alchemy has a chance to produce an extra serving of elixir and occasionally save ingredients from a batch!
Arcana.Witch.Perk.AlchemicalSavant.Name: Alchemical Savant
Arcana.Witch.Perk.AlchemicalSavant.Tagli: Brew extra elixirs and recover ingredients!
Arcana.Witch.Perk.ArcaneAscendancy.Descr: Some spend a lifetime studying the Craft. Few ever come to truly master it! {name} now possesses greater Magical Power reserves and a greater chance of success when casting magic.
Arcana.Witch.Perk.ArcaneAscendancy.Name: Arcane Ascendancy
Arcana.Witch.Perk.ArcaneAscendancy.Tagli: Increase Magical Power and spellcasting success!
Arcana.Witch.Perk.DarkArts.Description.1: They call {name} wicked. {name} prefers misunderstood! Negative emotions not caused by unmet Needs interfere less with spellcasting, and successfully cast magic may restore much of its spent Magical Power - especially curses.
Arcana.Witch.Perk.DarkArts.Name: Dark Arts
Arcana.Witch.Perk.DarkArts.Tagline: Turn dark emotions into magical strength!
Arcana.Witch.Perk.EideticWitchary.Descri: For some, magic is a lifetime of study. For {name}, it's becoming second nature! Magic below {name}'s current rank consumes slightly less Magical Power.
For some, magic is a lifetime of study. For {name}, it's practically instinct! Familiar magic now consumes even less Magical Power.
For some, magic is a lifetime of study. For {name}, it's as natural as breathing! Familiar magic now requires considerably less Magical Power.
Arcana.Witch.Perk.EideticWitchary.Name: Eidetic Witchary
Arcana.Witch.Perk.EideticWitchary.Taglin: Spend less Magical Power on familiar spells!
Arcana.Witch.Perk.FamiliarBond.Descripti: A witch is only as powerful as the company they keep plus the familiar by their side. With a bonded cat nearby, {name}'s magic uses less Magical Power. When a spell goes wrong, the familiar might even absorb its harmful backlash.
Arcana.Witch.Perk.FamiliarBond.Name: Familiar Bond
Arcana.Witch.Perk.FamiliarBond.Tagline: Cast more efficiently with a bonded familiar!
There is no defense against this witch's hex! {name} has learned to make curses consume less Magical Power and linger longer when their effects are timed. Some grudges are simply worth holding on to.
Arcana.Witch.Perk.Hexweaver.Name: Hexweaver
Arcana.Witch.Perk.LessonsInTheUnseenArts: Every Supreme was once a novice. Even the smallest incantation is worth mastering! {name} has learned to cast Novice and Apprentice magic while using less Magical Power.
Use less Magical Power on beginner spells!
Arcana.Witch.Perk.PowerShunt.Description: All magic comes at a price, and {name} knows how to pay it. By sacrificing personal Energy, {name} can restore a portion of their maximum Magical Power. This draining exchange cannot be attempted while exhausted and requires a full day's rest before it can be attempted again.
Arcana.Witch.Perk.PowerShunt.Name: Power Shunt
Arcana.Witch.Perk.PowerShunt.Tagline: Trade physical Energy for Magical Power!
Arcana.Witch.Perk.PracticallyMagic.Descr: You can't lose your power. You never will because it's inside of you. {name} can now cast spells without a wand! The magic comes from within, granting greater Spell Accuracy when casting with Magic Hands. Spells still consume Magical Power and can fizzle.
Arcana.Witch.Perk.PracticallyMagic.Name: Practically Magic
Arcana.Witch.Perk.RestForTheWicked.Descr: They say there's no rest for the wicked, but {name} knows better! A good night's sleep restores Magical Power a little faster.
They say there's no rest for the wicked, but {name} knows better! A good night's sleep now restores Magical Power considerably faster.
They say there's no rest for the wicked, but {name} knows better! {name} has perfected the art of magical rest, recovering Magical Power faster than ever while sleeping.
Arcana.Witch.Perk.RestForTheWicked.Name: Rest for the Wicked
Arcana.Witch.Perk.RestForTheWicked.Tagli: Recover more Magical Power while sleeping!
Why suffer the consequences of your own mistakes when someone else can suffer them for you? When a spell goes wrong, {name} can pass its harmful effects on to another nearby Sim. Whatever form they take, that's that Sim's problem!

Why suffer the consequences of your own mistakes when someone else can suffer them for you? {name} is getting better at passing the harmful effects of failed spells on to nearby Sims. Whatever happens to them next is their problem!

Why suffer the consequences of your own mistakes when someone else can suffer them for you? {name} has perfected the art of making nearby Sims deal with magical mistakes. Whatever form the consequences take, they are no longer {name}'s problem!
Arcana.Witch.Perk.Scapegoat.Name: Scapegoat
Arcana.Witch.Perk.Scapegoat.Tagline: Make another Sim pay for failed spells!
Arcana.Witch.Perk.SorcerersApprentice.De: There comes a time when the master must learn from the student. But today is not that day! {name} learns spells more readily from friendly witches and can study higher-tier spells through mentorship.
Arcana.Witch.Perk.SorcerersApprentice.Ta: Learn spells more easily from other witches!
Arcana.Witch.Perk.TheOldWays.Description: The oldest magic is seldom written down, and its greatest secrets are rarely shared willingly. {name} can perform rituals and cast Legendary spells using less Magical Power, while curses, rituals and Legendary spells have a greater chance of success.
Arcana.Witch.Perk.TheOldWays.Name: The Old Ways
Arcana.Witch.Perk.TheOldWays.Tagline: Strengthen curses, rituals and Legendary spells!
Arcana.Witch.Perk.ThePowerOfThree.Descri: One witch is powerful. Two are formidable. Three? Now that's a coven! When two friendly Witches are nearby, {name} regenerates Magical Power faster and is less likely to fail Tier I-III spells, charms and curses.
Arcana.Witch.Perk.ThePowerOfThree.Name: The Power of Three
Arcana.Witch.Perk.ThePowerOfThree.Taglin: Become stronger beside two friendly Witches!
Arcana.Witch.Perk.TheWitchingHour.Descri: When the clock strikes midnight, the world sleeps and the wicked get to work! From midnight until four in the morning, {name} restores Magical Power faster while awake and studies grimoires with unheard of speed.
Arcana.Witch.Perk.TheWitchingHour.Name: The Witching Hour
Arcana.Witch.Perk.TheWitchingHour.Taglin: Study and regain Magical Power faster at night!
Arcana.Witch.Perk.TravellingScholar.Desc: Magic is never made in the classroom but out in the field. With a little transmutation, {name} can temporarily turn an ordinary book into a grimoire and Study Spells wherever the road leads.
Arcana.Witch.Perk.TravellingScholar.Name: Travelling Scholar
Arcana.Witch.Perk.TrialByFire.Descriptio: Some witches prefer sharing their secrets. Others need a little persuasion! When {name} defeats a witch from another household in a magical duel, there's a chance to uncover a spell the rival knows.
Arcana.Witch.Perk.TrialByFire.Name: Trial by Fire
Arcana.Witch.Perk.TrialByFire.Tagline: Discover secret spells by winning magical duels!
Arcana.Witch.Rank.Description.Adept: Magic is no longer a stranger to you. You've earned your place in the magical hierarchy, and you can feel your power growing with each passing moment. Stay on this path, and you might just become the stuff legends are made of!
Arcana.Witch.Rank.Description.Apprentice: Practice makes perfect, and you can already feel your powers blossoming. There is still plenty to learn, but you think you're finally getting the hang of this weird thing called magic.
Arcana.Witch.Rank.Description.HighWitch: {Name} has become a pillar of the magical community! Whenever another witch needs guidance, advice, or a particularly troublesome curse lifted, they'll know exactly who to call.
Arcana.Witch.Rank.Description.Master: Years of study and dedication have paid off! {Name} has become a formidable witch, capable of wielding magic that most can only dream of mastering. Even the witches at the very top have taken notice!
Arcana.Witch.Rank.Description.Novice: Power isn't everything. Knowledge can best even the strongest warrior, or in this case, the strongest witch. And you want to learn it all! Study, bless, and even curse your way to the top!

Arcana.Study.NoEligible: There's nothing left to discover at this level of Magical Proficiency. Keep practicing to unlock more powerful magic!
Arcana.Study.CannotSave: The spell couldn't be learned. Try studying again.

Arcana.Spell.good_luck.Name: Good Luck Charm
Arcana.Spell.good_luck.Description: Bless a Sim with good luck.
Arcana.Spell.love.Name: Love Charm
Arcana.Spell.love.Description: Enchant a Sim with the power of love.
Arcana.Spell.sunlight.Name: Sunlight Charm
Arcana.Spell.sunlight.Description: Bathe a Sim in healing sunlight. Can also thaw a frozen Sim.
Arcana.Spell.pestilence.Name: Pestilence Curse
Arcana.Spell.pestilence.Description: Afflict a Sim with magical sickness.
Arcana.Spell.fire_blast.Name: Fire Blast
Arcana.Spell.fire_blast.Description: Unleash fire on another Sim, the ground or a frozen Sim.
Arcana.Spell.ice_blast.Name: Ice Blast
Arcana.Spell.ice_blast.Description: Chill a Sim, put out a fire or freeze plumbing.
Arcana.Spell.toadification.Name: Toadification Curse
Arcana.Spell.toadification.Description: Transform another Sim into a toad Sim.
Arcana.Spell.haunting.Name: Haunting Curse
Arcana.Spell.haunting.Description: Call a ghost to haunt a Sim.
Arcana.Spell.upgrade.Name: Magically Upgrade
Arcana.Spell.upgrade.Description: Magically apply an upgrade to an object.
Arcana.Spell.conversion.Name: Conversion Ritual
Arcana.Spell.conversion.Description: Transmute a collectible into another object.
Arcana.Spell.restoration.Name: Restoration Ritual
Arcana.Spell.restoration.Description: Clean and restore the entire lot.
Arcana.Spell.reanimation.Name: Reanimation Ritual
Arcana.Spell.reanimation.Description: Reanimate a deceased Sim as a zombie.
Arcana.Spell.charm_bladder.Name: Bladder Charm
Arcana.Spell.curse_bladder.Name: Bladder Curse
Arcana.Spell.charm_hunger.Name: Hunger Charm
Arcana.Spell.charm_hunger.Description: Restore a Sim's Hunger, or Thirst for a vampire.
Arcana.Spell.curse_hunger.Name: Hunger Curse
Arcana.Spell.curse_hunger.Description: Drain a Sim's Hunger, or Thirst for a vampire.
Arcana.Spell.charm_energy.Name: Energy Charm
Arcana.Spell.curse_energy.Name: Energy Curse
Arcana.Spell.charm_hygiene.Name: Hygiene Charm
Arcana.Spell.curse_hygiene.Name: Hygiene Curse
Arcana.Spell.charm_fun.Name: Fun Charm
Arcana.Spell.curse_fun.Name: Fun Curse
Arcana.Spell.charm_social.Name: Social Charm
Arcana.Spell.curse_social.Name: Social Curse
Arcana.Magic.ProficiencyIncreased: Magical Proficiency has increased! Study Spells to discover magic available at your rank.
Arcana.Spell.IceOtherTargets: Costs {0} Magical Power on fires and plumbing.
Arcana.Spell.SunlightOtherTargets: Costs {0} Magical Power to thaw a frozen Sim.
Arcana.Ability.ConjureApple.Name: Conjure Apple
Arcana.Ability.ConjureApple.Description: Conjure an apple out of thin air. A magical mishap can produce a poisoned apple.
Arcana.Ability.ConjurePoisonedApple.Name: Conjure Poisoned Apple
Arcana.Ability.ConjurePoisonedApple.Desc: Conjure a poisoned apple out of thin air.
Arcana.Cheat.UnlockAll.Help: unlockallspells - Teach all available ordinary spells, charms, curses and rituals to the selected Witch, Fairy or Genie. Proficiency stays unchanged.
Arcana.Cheat.SelectWitch: Select a Witch, Fairy or Genie in Live Mode, then enter unlockallspells.
Arcana.Cheat.CannotSave: The spells could not be learned. Please try again.
Arcana.Cheat.UnlockAll.Success: {0} now knows every available ordinary spell, charm, curse and ritual! Added {1} new discoveries. Magical Proficiency is unchanged.
Arcana.Skill.GenieMagic.Name: Genie Magic
Arcana.Skill.GenieMagic.Description: Genie Magic measures how well a Genie bends ordinary spellcraft to its own power. Study Spells at an alchemy station to raise it and unlock higher tiers of magic.
Arcana.Skill.GenieMagic.LevelUp: Genie Magic has increased! Study Spells to discover magic available at your new level.
Arcana.Genie.Rank.Description.UnChained: Once a sorcerer of terrible power, {Name} spent an age in chains for it. The chains are gone, but the magic still only answers in whispers. Time to make it listen again.
Arcana.Genie.Rank.Description.Awakened: The old power stirs! Spells that slipped through {Name}'s fingers now come when called, and the pull of the lamp grows weaker by the day.
Arcana.Genie.Rank.Description.Ascendant: {Name} remembers what they were before the lamp. Mortals have started to notice, and the lucky ones get a little help around the house.
Arcana.Genie.Rank.Description.Transcende: Few Genies ever reclaim enough power to bend another Sim's will. {Name} has, and "your wish is my command" now cuts both ways.
Arcana.Genie.Rank.Description.Almighty: No lamp can hold {Name} now. The oldest magic is theirs again, and little in the mortal world can stand against it.
Arcana.Cast.NotEnoughPower: Not enough power to cast this spell.
Arcana.Ability.fairy_aura.Name: Project Aura
Arcana.Ability.fairy_aura.Description: Radiate a fairy aura that helps nearby Sims. Fairies can project a creative, a mind or a soothing aura.
Arcana.Ability.fairy_trick.Name: Play Trick
Arcana.Ability.fairy_trick.Description: Play a mischievous fairy trick on another Sim.
Arcana.Ability.fairy_boon.Name: Bestow Fairy Gift
Arcana.Ability.fairy_boon.Description: Bless another Sim with a helpful fairy gift.
Arcana.Ability.fairy_trap.Name: Set Booby Trap
Arcana.Ability.fairy_trap.Description: Rig an object with a fairy trap that springs on the next Sim who uses it.
Arcana.Ability.fairy_repair.Name: Fairy Repair
Arcana.Ability.fairy_repair.Description: Mend a broken object with a touch of fairy magic.
Arcana.Ability.genie_meal.Name: Summon Food
Arcana.Ability.genie_meal.Description: Conjure a delicious meal out of thin air.
Arcana.Ability.genie_clean_sim.Name: Magically Clean
Arcana.Ability.genie_clean_sim.Descripti: Freshen up a Sim with a little Genie magic.
Arcana.Ability.genie_enchant_home.Name: Enchant Home
Arcana.Ability.genie_enchant_home.Descri: Restore order to a messy home with a sweep of Genie magic.
Arcana.Ability.genie_banish.Name: Banish Sim
Arcana.Ability.genie_banish.Description: Send an unwelcome visitor away with a little supernatural persuasion. They won't think much of the Genie afterwards.
Arcana.Ability.genie_ensorcel.Name: Ensorcel Sim
Arcana.Ability.genie_ensorcel.Descriptio: Temporarily bend another Sim to your will.
Arcana.Ability.genie_release.Name: Release Sim
Arcana.Ability.genie_release.Description: End an Ensorcelment early. It costs nothing and never fails.
Arcana.Ability.genie_lamp.Name: Return to Lamp
Arcana.Ability.genie_lamp.Description: Retreat into the comfort of your lamp, restoring your needs and replenishing your Magical Power.
Arcana.Journal.Overview.Backlash.Tagline: The chance that your Genie's magic rebounds, causing the spell to fizzle and leaving them with Magical Fizzle.
Arcana.Journal.Overview.Backlash.Base: Spells can rebound on success or failure. Perks can lower the chance to the minimum for that spell's tier.

Arcana.Genie.DelicateCasting.Name: Delicate Casting
Arcana.Genie.Perk.DomesticDjinn.Name: Domestic Djinn
Arcana.Genie.Perk.DomesticDjinn.Tagline: Spend less Magical Power on lesser Genie abilities!
Arcana.Genie.Perk.DomesticDjinn.Descript: A full table and a spotless home are the oldest forms of Genie hospitality. But {name} has learned that a little finesse goes a long way! Even the most familiar Genie powers now come with far less effort. Who needs to lift a finger when a little magic will do?
Recover more Magical Power while sleeping!
Every tale needs a night's rest before the next one begins. A good night's sleep restores {name}'s Magical Power a little faster.
Every tale needs a night's rest before the next one begins. A good night's sleep now restores {name}'s Magical Power considerably faster.
Every tale needs a night's rest before the next one begins. {name} has perfected the art of magical rest, recovering Magical Power faster than ever while sleeping.
Arcana.Genie.Perk.FinePrint.Name: Fine Print
Arcana.Genie.Perk.FinePrint.Tagline: A little caution goes a long way!
A carefully worded wish leaves less room for interpretation! Having learned that even the smallest mistake can carry dreadful consequences, {name} has discovered the value of taking a little extra care when casting magic. After all, one can never be too careful when dealing with the fine print! (Toggleable)
Arcana.Genie.Perk.Unbound.Name: Unbound
Arcana.Genie.Perk.Unbound.Tagline: Break the old bindings and embrace forbidden sorcery!
Arcana.Genie.Perk.Unbound.Description.1: The curse that once bound {name}'s magic has begun to weaken. Ancient sorcery that once scarred the land flows freely again! {name} can draw upon greater reserves of Magical Power and cast spells for less, but their innate Genie abilities now demand a greater price, and Backlash lingers longer.
Arcana.Genie.Perk.Lampbound.Name: Lampbound
Arcana.Genie.Perk.Lampbound.Tagline: Embrace the ancient traditions of Geniekind!
The lamp is no prison to those who have learned from their transgressions. Having reflected upon the past, {name} has chosen to embrace the ancient traditions of Geniekind rather than defy them. The secrets of those who came before now come more naturally, and the lamp no longer needs to whip {name} into submission. Yet with each passing day, the sorcery they once wielded so freely grows evermore distant.
Arcana.Genie.Perk.RisingTide.Name: Rising Tide
Arcana.Genie.Perk.RisingTide.Tagline: Grow stronger with every successful spell!
Arcana.Genie.Perk.RisingTide.Description: Let no man nor woman stand in {name}'s way! Every successful spell brings {name} closer to breaking the chains of old, restoring Magical Power faster and making their next spell more accurate. But beware! One unfortunate Backlash is all it takes to bring the tide crashing down.
Arcana.Genie.Perk.Wellspring.Name: Wellspring
Arcana.Genie.Perk.Wellspring.Tagline: Reclaim the Magical Power once sealed away!
Arcana.Genie.Perk.Wellspring.Description: The curse may have restrained {name}'s magic, but it could never extinguish it! As the old bindings weaken, a forgotten wellspring of Magical Power begins to flow once more.
The old bindings continue to weaken, and {name}'s once-forgotten magic is returning in force! What began as a trickle has become a steady stream of Magical Power.
What was once a trickle has become a torrent! {name} has reclaimed an immense reserve of Magical Power, and the curse that once contained it can barely hold back the flood.
Arcana.Genie.Perk.PocketPalace.Name: Pocket Palace
Arcana.Genie.Perk.PocketPalace.Tagline: Make yourself at home, wherever home may be!
Arcana.Genie.Perk.PocketPalace.Descripti: What was once a prison is now your one and only garden of Eden! Having grown accustomed to life within the lamp, {name} has discovered that its walls hold far more than they once imagined. The comforts of home now tend to {name}'s every need, and even the familiar grounds surrounding the lamp seem to restore their magic.
Arcana.Genie.Perk.SilkenCommand.Name: Silken Command
Arcana.Genie.Perk.SilkenCommand.Tagline: Bend others to your will with a few chosen words!
Arcana.Genie.Perk.SilkenCommand.Descript: Why waste powerful sorcery when a few well-chosen words will suffice? {name} has grown accustomed to the ancient art of Genie enchantment, weaving commands so persuasive that few can resist their influence. Even banishing unwanted guests can now be done with a little more grace, though their gratitude is hardly guaranteed!
Arcana.Genie.Perk.FugitiveOfOld.Name: Fugitive of Old
Arcana.Genie.Perk.FugitiveOfOld.Tagline: Reclaim forbidden Witch magic and turn Backlash against Fate!
Arcana.Genie.Perk.FugitiveOfOld.Descript: Let the High Witches come and the Rulers of Fate flee! {name} has dealt a great strike to the powers that sought to chain them, and not even backlashes can stop them now! Backlashes now restore a portion of spent magical energy when unleashed.
Arcana.Genie.Perk.HeartsDesire.Name: Heart's Desire
Arcana.Genie.Perk.HeartsDesire.Tagline: The heart wants what the heart wants!
Arcana.Genie.Perk.HeartsDesire.Descripti: A thousand spells could never satisfy the desires of a single mortal heart! Having spent centuries answering the wishes of others, {name} has learned that the greatest power lies in knowing what someone truly desires. A whispered secret, a carefully granted favor, and perhaps a little gratitude in return! After all, even the kindest Genie deserves something for their troubles.
Arcana.Genie.Perk.Unleashed.Name: Unleashed
Arcana.Genie.Perk.Unleashed.Tagline: Let no consequence stand in the way of magic!
Free from the bonds that once held them down, {name}'s sorcery has returned to its former grandeur. Let the consequences be damned! Even when Backlash strikes, {name}'s spells will see their purpose through. And if someone else must suffer the consequences? So be it!
Arcana.Genie.Perk.Counterattack.Name: Counterattack
Arcana.Genie.Perk.Counterattack.Tagline: Turn the power of Fate against its masters!
Arcana.Genie.Perk.Counterattack.Descript: For centuries, {name} has granted the wishes of others while their own desires went unanswered. No longer! Having reclaimed the sorcery once stolen from them, it's time for {name} to go on the offensive and steal power from those who sought to imprison them. But the Rulers of Fate have not forgotten those who once defied them, and all magic comes with a price. Let Fate decide what that price shall be!
Arcana.Genie.Perk.LawOfTheLamp.Name: Law of the Lamp
Arcana.Genie.Perk.LawOfTheLamp.Tagline: A promise made is a promise kept!
Arcana.Genie.Perk.LawOfTheLamp.Descripti: For centuries, {name} was forced to serve the wishes of others, punished whenever the Rulers of Fate deemed a bargain unworthy. No longer! Having mastered the ancient laws of Geniekind, {name} now grants wishes for other Sims by choice rather than command. The lamp that once demanded their obedience now answers to them, and when a promise is made under the Law of the Lamp, not even the Rulers of Fate may break it!
Arcana.Genie.Perk.GenieLaw.Name: Genie Law
Arcana.Genie.Perk.GenieLaw.Tagline: Master the ancient laws of Geniekind!
Arcana.Genie.Perk.GenieLaw.Description.1: All magic comes at a price, every deal has its conditions, and every law has its loopholes! The laws that once bound {name} in servitude have now become their moral code. Having mastered the ancient laws of Geniekind, {name} is no longer a prisoner of the lamp, but its master! Wishes are now granted with greater certainty, and the powers that once commanded {name} must now answer to them.
Arcana.Genie.Benefit.HeartAsk: Ask About a Sim's Heart's Desire
Arcana.Genie.Benefit.Redirect: {0} Backlash Redirect (Nearest Sim, Once per Day)
Arcana.Genie.Benefit.NoFail: Spells No Longer Fail from Backlash
Arcana.Genie.Benefit.GuaranteedWish: Automatically Guarantees One Wish Every 7 Days
Arcana.Genie.Benefit.GuaranteedSafe: The Guaranteed Wish Uses Remaining Power and Ignores Wish Exhaustion
Arcana.Genie.Rain.Name: Fortune's Rain
Arcana.Genie.Rain.Summoned: {0} has been gifted with Fortune's Rain! The clouds should roll in shortly.
Arcana.Genie.Rain.Failed: {0} could not find favor with The Weather Stone.
Arcana.Genie.Exhaustion.Description: Granting a wish takes everything a Genie has. Magical Power will be slow to return and won't recover all the way, so ordinary wishes will have to wait until this wears off.
Arcana.Genie.Exhaustion.Name: Wish Exhaustion
Arcana.Genie.Fate.DeathsDue: Fate has come to collect its due, and the price is {0}'s life.
Arcana.Genie.Fate.ChainsOfOld: The chains of old bind once more! {0}'s Magical Power won't replenish while they hold, but no chains last forever...
Arcana.Genie.Fate.FortunesDebt: Who knew wishes were so expensive? A quarter of the household's Simoleons just went straight into Fate's pocket!
Arcana.Genie.Fate.FatesMisfortune: {0} has fallen out of Fate's favor. Better steer clear of ladders and black cats for a while!
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Waiting: Recently shared a heart's desire. Try again in a few days.
Arcana.Genie.Wishes.WorldPeace.Name: World Peace
Arcana.Genie.Wishes.Resurrect.Name: Resurrect Sim
Arcana.Genie.Wishes.MoreWishes.Name: More Wishes
Arcana.Genie.Wishes.Love.Name: Love
Arcana.Genie.Wishes.LongLife.Name: Long Life
Arcana.Genie.Wishes.LargeFamily.Name: Large Family
Arcana.Genie.Wishes.Happiness.Name: Happiness
Arcana.Genie.Wishes.Fortune.Name: Fortune
Arcana.Genie.Wishes.Beauty.Name: Beauty
Arcana.Genie.Wishes.FreeGenie.Name: Free the Genie
Arcana.Genie.Wishes.CheatDeath.Name: Power to Cheat Death
Arcana.Genie.Wishes.Youth.Name: Youth
Arcana.Genie.Wishes.Fame.Name: Fame
Arcana.Genie.Wishes.DeathEscaped: {0} has cheated death! The Grim Reaper had to leave empty-handed, but he isn't the type to give up easily.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.Beauty.Name: Wish Gone Wrong
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.Beauty.Description: After that wish, the mirror should have become a best friend. Now it's clearly holding a grudge.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.Joy.Name: Pure Bliss
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.Joy.Description: Life has never felt this good! Every little worry has packed its bags and left town.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.Career.Name: Wish Gone Wrong
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.Career.Description: That wish was supposed to give this Sim a leg up at work. Instead, the daily grind feels worse than ever.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.Love.Name: Smitten
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.Love.Description: Every thought keeps drifting back to one particular Sim. Is this what being head over heels feels like?
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Dialog.Description.Che: Give the Grim Reaper the slip. Old age still wins in the end.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Dialog.Description.You: Turn back the clock and be a Young Adult again.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.GoneWrong.Name: Wish Gone Wrong
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.GoneWrong.Descript: Well, that's not what anyone had in mind! Wishes are a lot trickier than they look.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.OtherDescription: Make another Sim's wish come true, though wishes don't always turn out quite as expected.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.OwnDescription: Bend reality to your will, but beware the price Fate may demand.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Failure.World: {0} wished for world peace, but the world didn't get the memo. Everyone seems grumpier than ever!
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Failure.WorldMisery: The world answered {0}'s wish for misery with hugs, compliments and sunshine. How dreadful!
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Failure.Resurrect: {1} is back... as a ghost. Not quite the reunion {0} had in mind!
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Failure.More: No such luck! {0} asked for more wishes and got exactly zero in return.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Failure.LongLife: Oops! Somewhere along the way, {0}'s longer life turned into a shorter one. A few days have been shaved right off.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Failure.Family: It seems the stork didn't get the message! {0}'s wish for a bigger family went unanswered.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Failure.Fortune: {0} wished for a fortune and got a visit from the Repoman instead. Better hide the good furniture!
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Failure.Beauty: That wish for beauty backfired! Romance won't come easily to {0} for a couple of days.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Failure.Freedom: Rather than being freed, the Genie gave {0} the slip and ran off with the lamp to find a new owner!
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Failure.Youth: Uh oh! Instead of growing younger, {0} just got older.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Failure.Scandal: Scandal! The tabloids are buzzing with a juicy story about {0}. It isn't true, but try telling that to the fans.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Failure.Fame: {0} wanted to be the talk of the town. Now {0} is, but for all the wrong reasons.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Failure.LoveReveal: The love {0} wished for didn't last. Yesterday's sweetheart can't stand to be in the same room now!
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Failure.HappinessRevea: The smile is gone. {0}'s wished-for happiness has worn off, and the crash that followed isn't pretty.
Arcana.Genie.Fate.ThingYouLoveMost: The power to change reality doesn't come cheap. Fate has claimed {1}'s life as payment, leaving a hole in {0}'s heart that no wish can fill.
Arcana.Genie.Fate.ForgottenLove: Love is weakness, or so you tell yourself. {1} no longer remembers a thing about {0}, and the two are strangers once again.
Arcana.Genie.Fate.SlapOnTheWrist: Not even Fate could hold {0} down this time! The wish is granted, and nothing was taken in return.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Success.Peace: Peace has broken out all over town! Even the grumpiest neighbors are smiling, and {0} couldn't be prouder.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Success.Misery: The whole world seems a little gloomier today, and {0} is loving every minute of it.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Success.Resurrect: {1} has returned from the great beyond! Thanks to {0}'s wish, death turned out to be only a minor setback.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Success.More: It worked! {0} wished for more wishes, and the lamp now has {1} left to grant.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Success.Love: {1} has fallen madly in love with {0}! Who says you can't wish for romance?
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Success.LongLife: {0} will live a longer life! That's plenty of extra time to work through the bucket list.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Success.Family: {0}'s chances of a bigger family just got a whole lot better. Time to start shopping for cribs!
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Success.Happiness: {0} has been granted true happiness! That smile isn't going anywhere.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Success.Fortune: {0}'s wish came through in a big way! §{1} has been added to the household funds.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Success.Beauty: {0} is now stunningly beautiful! Other Sims can't help but take a second look.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Success.Freedom: {0} has started the Genie down the road to freedom! First, though, the lamp will need to spend some time on ice.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Success.CheatDeath: {0} now holds the power to cheat death! The next time the Grim Reaper comes calling, he may have to come back another day. Old age, of course, is another matter.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Success.Youth: {0} is a Young Adult again! Those gray hairs and creaky knees are already a distant memory.
Arcana.Genie.Wish.Success.Fame: {0}'s celebrity status just went up a star! Better get used to the flash of cameras.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.HomeSweetLamp.Name: Home Sweet Lamp
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.HomeSweetLamp.Desc:
It's bigger on the inside, quieter than any bedroom and the perfect place for a Genie to rest up and recharge.
(From Resting in the Lamp)
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.PeaceTurnedSour.De: Everyone is being so nice, and it's revolting. Couldn't somebody, somewhere, be having a rotten day?
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.MiseryTurnedSour.D: So much for world peace. Somehow the whole town ended up in a foul mood, and it's contagious.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.UnfinishedBusiness: Someone came back from beyond the grave, but only as a ghost. It's hard to have a heartfelt reunion with a Sim who's see-through.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.LoveUnwished.Name: Love Expired
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.LoveUnwished.Descr: True love lasted all of one day. Wishes really should come with a warranty.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.BorrowedTime.Name: Time Slipped Away
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.BorrowedTime.Descr: Wasn't there more time left than this? Somehow, a few precious days of life have gone missing.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.EmptyNest.Name: Empty Nest
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.EmptyNest.Descript: A bigger family was the wish. So far, the nursery is just as quiet as it was before.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.JoyGone.Name: Happiness on Loan
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.JoyGone.Descriptio: All that happiness was only on loan, and it's been paid back with interest. Even sunny days look a little gray now.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.RepossessedWish.De: A fortune was going to come knocking any minute now. Then the Repoman knocked first.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.FleetingYouth.Name: Fleeting Youth
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.FleetingYouth.Desc: Is that a new wrinkle? Wishing for youth wasn't meant to work in reverse.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.BadName.Name: Infamous
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.BadName.Descriptio: This is not the kind of fame anyone wishes for. Sims around town are whispering, and none of it is flattering.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.EmptyLamp.Name: Out of Wishes
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.EmptyLamp.Descript: Wishing for more wishes seemed like a clever loophole. The lamp didn't agree.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.GenieEscaped.Name: Gone With the Lamp
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.GenieEscaped.Descr: Setting the Genie free didn't go as planned. The Genie is gone, the lamp is gone, and nobody even said thank you.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.Chains.Name: Chains of Old
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.Chains.Description: Fate has put the old shackles back on. Whatever Magical Power is left will have to last until they come off.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.BeautyTurned.Name: Beauty Backfired
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.BeautyTurned.Descr: Every compliment comes out wrong and every wink gets an eye roll. Flirting is a lost cause for the time being.
Arcana.Genie.Benefit.HeartBlessings: Grant Genie Blessings to Other Sims
Arcana.Genie.Benefit.HeartFulfilled: Fulfilling a Revealed Desire Doubles a Blessing's Duration
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Fortune.Name: Blessing of Fortune
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Fortune.Descriptio: Bestow good fortune upon another Sim, bringing them luck and a little extra prosperity.
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Fortune.Granted: With the Blessing of Fortune, {0} is in for a lucky streak, and work is about to pay a little better, too!
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Vitality.Name: Blessing of Vitality
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Vitality.Descripti: Invigorate another Sim, keeping their needs fulfilled longer, improving their athletic abilities and granting them greater strength and endurance.
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Vitality.Granted: {0} has received the Blessing of Vitality and is bursting with energy! It's the perfect time to hit the gym.
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Inspiration.Name: Blessing of Inspiration
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Inspiration.Descri: Awaken another Sim's creative potential, helping them develop their skills, study magic, finish paintings and novels with greater ease and create finer paintings, novels and meals.
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Inspiration.Grante: The Blessing of Inspiration has {0}'s mind racing with ideas. Picking up new skills should be easier than usual!
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Harmony.Name: Blessing of Harmony
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Harmony.Descriptio: Help another Sim find friendship and romance, smoothing their conversations and easing the sting of unpleasant encounters.
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Harmony.Granted: Thanks to the Blessing of Harmony, making friends and finding romance should come a little easier to {0}.
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Cooldown: This Sim has received a blessing too recently.
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Protection.Name: Blessing of Protection
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Protection.Descrip: Watch over another Sim, shielding them from hostile magic and shortening magical misfortune. Even a Genie's protection has its limits.
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Protection.Granted: {0} is now under the Blessing of Protection. Harmful magic will have a harder time getting through!
Arcana.Genie.Blessing.Protection.Resiste: That spell bounced right off! {0}'s Blessing of Protection kept the magic from taking hold.
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Fulfilled: That's exactly what {0} was hoping for! The blessing will last twice as long, and this kindness won't soon be forgotten.
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Mistaken: {0} manages a polite thank you, but it's clear that wasn't the right blessing.
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Fortune.1: Money's been tight lately. A few extra Simoleons would really help.
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Fortune.2: Everyone else gets all the lucky breaks. When's it going to be my turn?
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Fortune.3: Every time I open the mailbox, there's another bill waiting for me.
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Fortune.4: Just once, I'd love to buy something nice without checking my bank account first.
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Vitality.1: I can barely make it through the day without a nap.
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Vitality.2: I keep saying I'll get in shape, but I run out of steam so fast!
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Vitality.4: I'd love to be strong enough to carry all the groceries in one trip.
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Inspiration.1: I've been staring at the same blank page for days. Where did all my ideas go?
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Inspiration.2: There's so much I want to learn, but it all goes in one ear and out the other!
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Inspiration.3: I want to make something amazing, but every idea I have falls flat.
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Inspiration.4: I practice and practice, but I never seem to get any better.
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Harmony.1: I never know what to say to people. Why is making friends so hard?
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Harmony.2: Every date I go on ends in disaster. Is a little romance too much to ask?
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Harmony.3: Sometimes I feel like nobody really gets me.
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Harmony.4: Why does every conversation I have turn into an argument?
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Protection.1: I can't shake the feeling that something bad is about to happen.
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Protection.2: Trouble follows me wherever I go!
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Protection.3: Lately it feels like someone's put a hex on me.
Arcana.Genie.HeartsDesire.Protection.4: With all the strange things going on around here, I'd feel better if someone was looking out for me.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.BlessingFortune.De: Lady Luck is in a generous mood! Good things keep happening, and every paycheck comes with a few extra Simoleons tucked inside.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.BlessingVitality.D: Every muscle feels limber and strong! Workouts are easier, and hunger and fatigue are having a hard time keeping up.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.BlessingInspiratio: Everything just clicks today! There's never been a better time to learn something new, from guitar chords to brand-new spells.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.BlessingHarmony.De: Conversations come easily, jokes actually land and flirting feels natural. Even when things get awkward, the sting doesn't last long.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.BlessingProtection: Hexes and curses just don't seem to stick like they used to. Somebody up there must be looking out for this Sim... or somebody in a lamp, anyway.
Arcana.Genie.WishBuff.HeartsDesireFulfil: Somebody was actually listening! It's a wonderful feeling when someone knows just what you need.
It's the thought that counts, right? Still, that blessing missed the mark.
Arcana.Witch.Rank.Description.Uninitiate: The magic is there, humming quietly in {Name}'s blood, but it hasn't been coaxed out yet. A little practice with a wand should wake it right up.
Arcana.Genie.Rank.Description.Dormant: An age in a lamp leaves anyone a little stiff. {Name}'s magic is still yawning and stretching, but a few practiced tricks will shake off the dust.
Arcana.Fairy.Rank.Description.Budding: {Name}'s wings are still finding their flutter. Every fairy has to start somewhere, and this one is only just beginning to bloom.
